messages:
noah_cs: Pulled this quarter's onboarding + NPS feature asks. Raw CSV attached in drive. Need a quick mapping: raw_text -> signal_tag -> priority. Can product/eng weigh in?

arne_product: Yep. paste a few real rows so we can see noise.

noah_cs: sample rows (very noisy):
```
customers say tokens expire in middle of guided setup, "onboarding/kv-expiry", high
need local-embeddings for private vector search, "feature/embeddings-local", med
demo traffic causes 503s on generation endpoints, "serving/endpoint-throttle", high
confusing pricing for reserved GPU pools, "billing/reserved-pricing", low
model outputs differ between hosted and vpc deploys, "model/drift-hosted-vpc", med
console should let us pin model per route, "ux/console-pin", med
```

kei_pm: How are you calculating "priority"? renewal risk vs mention volume vs engineering effort?

noah_cs: Heuristic we used: priority_score = 0.5*renewal_risk + 0.3*normalized_volume + 0.2*(1 - estimated_effort). Numbers from CS signals + last 6 weeks of mentions. Intended as draft for product to sanity-check.

ellie_research: Can we add repeat_count and sentiment_score columns, plus origin (onboarding, support, renewal convo, demo)? Helps stability of the heuristic.

noah_cs: Yep — will append repeat_count, sentiment_score, origin, and a short "how_mentioned" excerpt for human validation. Also flag top-10 accounts for renewals.

jamie_eng: To route to eng infra vs runtime, can we standardize tags? e.g., serve/perf vs serving/ops overlaps a lot. Would prefer a canonical taxonomy.

arne_product: Proposed canonical tags: onboarding, serving-performance, billing, security-compliance, console-ux, model-behavior, embeddings, reserved-capacity. Thoughts?

kei_pm: Add a column with account names for the most repeated asks so renewal managers can follow up.

ellie_research: I'll run a small weekly precision check on the mapping and report improvements.

noah_cs: Actions:
- I'll produce cleaned CSV with repeat_count, sentiment_score, origin, exemplar text, and top-10 at-risk accounts by EOD (1799991290).
- Arne/Kei: please confirm canonical tags and whether we should bump renewal weight to 0.6.
- Jamie: can you confirm auto-route rules for serving-performance/reserved-capacity -> infra?

CSBot: Upload hint — filename must be: cs-feedback-mapping-1799991290.csv if you want bot auto-detect :robot_face:

noah_cs: Uploaded: https://drive.shared/redwood/cs-feedback-mapping-1799991290.csv — ~410 rows, includes sentiment and repeat_count. Ping me for a 15-min walkthrough. :thumbsup:

arne_product: Let's sync Wed 11am to finalize and push top 5 items into product backlog. Thanks everyone :pray:
